annotations.title: Set the widget wording for one language

description: Set the chat widget's greeting, agent name and bubble text for one language. A visitor in that language sees this wording instead of the default.

ai_support_name.description: Agent name shown in the header.

initial_message.description: The greeting the visitor sees first.

language_code.description: Language code, for example de or fr.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.
